newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers rise on renewed Iraq/US tensions.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers rise on renewed Iraq/US tensions.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Thursday were quoted higher, supported by high cargo levels and renewed US/Iraq tensions, brokers said.
Bids for 380 cst were quoted between $118-$120, higher from late Wednesday's levels at $114-$116. Indications for 180-cst also rose to around $124, up from $119-$121 on Wednesday.
"Enquiries were thin amid the Iraq/US tensions as buyers were sidelined," said a trader. "As prices in Singapore remain high, we prefer to cover our requirments from South Korea," said a shipowner.
MDO was steady at $200-$205, gas oil at $215-$216. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
